<?php

require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;

$student = User::where('role', 'student')->whereNotNull('program_id')->first();
$collegeId = $student?->program?->college_id;
$staff = User::query()->staffResponsibleFor($collegeId)->orderBy('name')->get();

// Render the exact component markup the appointment form uses.
$blade = '<x-form.select name="staff_id" :label="\'HDC staff member\'" :required="true" :placeholder="\'Select a staff member\'">'
    .'@foreach ($staff as $staffMember)'
    .'<option value="{{ $staffMember->id }}" @selected((string) old(\'staff_id\') === (string) $staffMember->id)>{{ $staffMember->name }} ({{ $staffMember->role->label() }})</option>'
    .'@endforeach'
    .'</x-form.select>';

echo Blade::render($blade, ['staff' => $staff]).PHP_EOL;
